Title: ODC accession number
Description: ODC-SCI assigned accession number (dataset ID); automatically assigned at time of dataset creation

Title: DOI
Description: DOI assigned to dataset; assigned by ODC-SCI when approved for publication

Title: Dataset title
Description: Published dataset title

Title: Dataset type
Description: Identifies type of data contained in dataset; datasets may include one or more types of data [Permitted Values: Animal: data produced from animal subjects. Clinical: data produced from human subjects (deidentified). In vitro: data produced from cell culture. Other: data produced from other source (i.e. synthetic and/or derived from previously published source).]
PVDescribed: Animal: data produced from animal subjects. Clinical: data produced from human subjects (deidentified). In vitro: data produced from cell culture. Other: data produced from other source (i.e. synthetic and/or derived from previously published source).

Title: Publication year
Description: Calendar year dataset was published on ODC-SCI

Title: Publication date
Description: Date of publication to ODC-SCI Public Space (i.e., activation of DOI by Laboratory PI)

Title: Laboratory name
Description: Name of the verified laboratory on ODC-SCI that published the dataset

Title: Study leader
Description: Name of person(s) responsible for overseeing the project(s) that created the data

Title: Number of unique subjects in dataset
Description: Total number of unique subjects reported in dataset (animal and/or deidentified human subjects); unique subject IDs associated with In vitro (cell) data are EXCLUDED from this count

Title: Species type(s) in dataset
Description: Name of species type(s) reported in dataset [Permitted Values: Cat; Human (deidentified); Monkey; Mouse; Pig; Rat]
PermittedValues: Cat; Human (deidentified); Monkey; Mouse; Pig; Rat
PVDescribed: Cat. Human (deidentified). Monkey. Mouse. Pig. Rat.

Title: Strain type(s) in dataset
Description: Name of strain type(s) reported in dataset

Title: Sex type(s) in dataset
Description: Sex type(s) reported in dataset
PVDescribed: Female. Male. Unknown: data marked unknown by author. Not reported: data not reported and/or variable missing from dataset

Title: Vendor or origin of the subjects
Description: Vendor or origin of research subjects reported in dataset

Title: Age range of subjects
Description: Age range of subjects in the dataset as reported by the authors in the narrative summary and/or subject data file; timing of reported age is NOT standardised across datasets to a single specific experimental time/milestone (e.g., injury, treatment, etc.)

Title: Weight range of subjects
Description: Weight range of subjects reported in dataset; timing of reported weight measurement is NOT standardised across datasets to a single specific experimental time/milestone (e.g., injury, treatment, etc.)

Title: Type or model of injury
Description: Type(s) or model(s) of spinal cord injury reported in the dataset [Permitted Values: Contusion; Crush; Dorsal column lesion; DLQ; Hemisection; SNI; Transection; Neurologically intact]
PermittedValues: Contusion; Crush; Dorsal column lesion; DLQ; Hemisection; SNI; Transection
PVDescribed: Contusion. Crush. Dorsal column lesion. DLQ: Dorsolateral Quadrant. Hemisection. SNI: Spared Nerve Injury. Transection

Title: Anatomical level of spinal cord injury
Description: Anatomical level of spinal cord injury [Permitted Values: Cervical; Thoracic; Lumbar]

Title: Spinal cord level of the injury
Description: Spinal cord level at which the injury was performed including segment and number (e.g. C5)

Title: Injury laterality
Description: Laterality of planned SCI lesion (i.e. the side that was affected during surgical induction of SCI)

Title: Device used for injury
Description: Name of the device(s) used for the injury

Title: Injury severity
Description: Injury severity as reported in dataset and/or dataset metadata [Permitted Values in contusion models: Mild; Moderate; Severe; in transection models: Incomplete; Complete; in clinical data: AIS score; Not reported]
PermittedValues: Mild; Moderate; Severe; Incomplete; Complete; AIS score A-E; Not reported
PVDescribed: Mild. Moderate. Severe. Incomplete. Complete. AIS score A-E. Not reported.

Title: Intended contusion force
Description: Intended (programmed) contusion force in kilodynes (kdyn); archival data from studies using the NYU/MASCIS impactor report the weight drop height in millimetres (mm)

Title: Contusion model data available
Description: A list of programmed and actual contusion model parameters reported in dataset and/or dataset metadata [Permitted Values: Force; Displacement; Velocity; Dwell time; Tip size; Weight; Weight drop height]
PermittedValues: Force; Displacement; Velocity; Dwell time; Tip size; Weight; Weight drop height
PVDescribed: Force: Actual force reported by impactor. Displacement: Actual measure of spinal cord tissue displacement (dorsal-ventral) reported by impactor. Dwell time: Programmed impactor dwell time. Velocity: Actual velocity of impact reported by impactor. Weight. Weight drop height. Tip size: Impactor tip size.

Title: Locomotor behaviour tests
Description: A list of locomotor behaviour tests [Permitted Values: BBB: Basso-Beattie-Bresnahan locomotor score; BMS: Basso Mouse Scale for locomotion; Ladder walking]
PVDescribed: BBB: Basso-Beattie-Bresnahan locomotor score. BMS: Basso Mouse Scale for locomotion. Ladder walking.

Title: Behaviour tests (non-locomotor)
Description: A list of non-locomotor behaviour tests reported in dataset

Title: Intervention type
Description: Broad classification of intervention type(s) reported in dataset [Permitted Values: Drug/agent; Neuromodulation; Diet; Environmental; Fecal microbiota transplant; Genetic; Graft/cellular; Optogenetic; Rehabilitative training]
PermittedValues: Drug/agent; Neuromodulation; Diet; Environmental; Fecal microbiota transplant; Genetic; Graft/cellular; Optogenetic; Rehabilitative training
PVDescribed: Drug/agent. Neuromodulation. Diet. Environmental. Fecal microbiota transplant. Genetic. Graft/cellular. Optogenetic. Rehabilitative training.

Title: Intervention agent
Description: Name and/or description of intervention agent/technique

Title: Author keywords
Description: Author keywords in metadata

Title: Related datasets
Description: Related datasets on ODC-SCI (e.g., datasets that contain the same subjects and/or contain related experimental data)

Title: Funders
Description: Funding agencies and/or institutions that provided support for the work described in the dataset

Title: CoDEs
Description: Indicates whether the dataset was published before or after the introduction of the data standards known as the Community Data Elements (CoDEs) [Permitted Values: Pre; Post]

Title: Study purpose
Description: Study purpose as described in metadata

Title: Notes
Description: Notes
